backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing three HDDHub-related feature requirements and associated files/components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files, describing each component’s role in the app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind setup defining color tokens, dark theme overrides, and base styling.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React layout combining category list, HDDHub visualization, vinyl player overlay, and modal handling.
frontend/src/components/CategoryModal.ts: Accessible glass-style modal showing category name and description.
frontend/src/components/HDDHub.tsx: HDD visualization computing arm rotation, platter spin, and glow-ring geometry based on category state.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioShell.t: Shell component applying dimmed background image and wrapping page content.
frontend/src/components/VinylPlayer.tsx: Vinyl player with play/pause control, compact mode, and looping audio behavior.
frontend/src/data/categories.ts: Defines a Category interface and exports a list of category objects with ids, names, and descriptive text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current Internet Identity, invalidating related queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context/provider handling identity loading, login, logout, and status management using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles, theme CSS variables, dark mode tokens, global typography, and custom utility animations.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function that merges class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders the root component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended theme variables, custom animations, and plugins.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Configures Vite with React, environment variable support, path aliases, dev proxy, and build settings.
project_state.json: Describes the portfolio project's architecture, UI interactions, assets, and known issues, including HDD hub and vinyl behavior.
